$comment: Single source of truth for the CI/local build. Each release lists the Spriggit YAML folders to deserialize and where the built .esp lands inside the release (FOMOD) tree. 'dest' paths must match the source= attributes in that release's fomod/ModuleConfig.xml (verified by build/build.ps1 -CheckFomod). Paths are repo-relative, and every patch's sources live under src/<PatchName>/. Optional per-release keys: 'scripts' {from,to} bulk-copies committed .pex; 'allowUnreferencedPlugins' silences the warning about a plugin the FOMOD never installs; 'fomod': false ships a plain archive with no installer - the right shape whenever the install has nothing to ask (a single .esp with no options, e.g. a replacement plugin), and build/staging/<name>/fomod/ must then not exist. Optional per-plugin key: 'scripts' [{from,to}] copies individual .pex. Add releases with the /mod-new-plugin skill. An empty 'releases' array is valid - the build reports 'nothing to build' and succeeds, so the repo stays green before the first patch exists.

releases.$comment: ZEN edition: a SUPERSET of the release above, shipped under the SAME plugin filename so the two are mutually exclusive - install whichever matches the build of johnskyrim's mod you own. releases.$comment: Single placed-ref override, CONFIRMED WORKING in-game. Fixes the Ark Myrad boarding sequence dropping the player off the platform edge before the mount animation completes. Repositions reference 02F0B5:Enderal - Forgotten Stories.esm (a plain XMarker) toward the platform's east edge, giving the Myrad's westward-facing neck room before running off the platform's short axis. This is the ACTUAL takeoff marker - reached via keyword _00E_FS_MyradTakeOffMarker (02F0B6) on the Forgotten Stories OVERRIDE of Ark_MyradRef, not the base Skyrim.esm layer. See CLAUDE.md's Allocations-in-use postmortem for the full investigation; the short version is that Ark_MyradRef's own placement (09C522) and the base-game '_00E_MyradStartPosition' marker (09C521) are both red herrings that this repo spent an entire session editing before finding the real record.
releases.name: Zenderal - Ark Myrad Platform Fix

releases.$comment: MCO/ADXP setups only. Attack MCO-DXP's Nemesis patch reroutes only the standing power-attack state into MCO_PowerAttack, and Attack_MCO.esp only redirects PowerAttackForward (019B25) to attackPowerStartInPlace. PowerAttackLeft/Backward/Right (019B22/23/24) still fire vanilla attackPowerStartLeft/Backward/Right, so side/back power attacks play Enderal's vanilla animations and For Honor Reforged's DMK-gated directional power attacks never trigger. This overrides those three idles with attackPowerStartInPlace - the same one-field change Attack_MCO makes to 019B25 - every other field verbatim. Only Skyrim.esm defines these records in the list. Also drops the vanilla Critical Charge/Great Critical Charge HasPerk condition from the sprint power-attack idles 0EC3CC/0EC3CE/0EC3CF (Update.esm winners), the only senders of attackPowerStart_Sprint on MCO - nothing in Enderal grants those perks, so FHR's MCO_SprintPowerAttack was unreachable. Do NOT install with BFCO.
releases.name: Zenderal - MCO Directional Power Attacks
